description: Rossendale Borough Council's published feed contains 3,167 REDACTED rows (~7.5% of the corpus). These are fostering / SGO payments passed through the district on behalf of the county's Children's Services — the district acts as paymaster but the recipients are named individuals lawfully redacted under Care Act 2014 + UK GDPR. Default is procurement_paid; REDACTED rows bucket to direct_payment_individual.

rules.reason: Care Act 2014 + UK GDPR redactions — direct payments to individuals (foster carers, SGO recipients, ASC service-user direct payments, CYP direct payments, Staying Put arrangements). Lawfully unnamed.
